You'll keep paid access until the end of the billing period you've paid for and you won't be charged again.
If you subscribed in the Substack iOS app, you'll need to cancel through the Apple App Store.
In-app paid subscriptions don't include the option to pause.
substack.notes: Steps not paraphrased; follow evidence excerpts / source page.

sunbasket.source_title: How do I cancel my Sunbasket subscription?
evidence_excerpts: Log In : Go to sunbasket.com and sign in to your account.

Navigate to Account Settings : Click on your profile name or icon, then select Account Settings Manage Subscription : Click on Manage My Subscription Cancel Subscription : Click on Cancel My Subscription Confirm Cancellation : Follow the prompts to confirm your cancellation.
You will be asked to provide a reason for canceling.
After cancellation, you should receive a confirmation email from Sunbasket.
sunbasket.notes: Steps not paraphrased; follow evidence excerpts / source page.

evidence_excerpts: Individual Users To cancel your Superhuman Mail subscription, hit Cmd+K (Mac) or Ctrl+K (Windows) → Cancel Subscription or log into superhuman.com/admin .
Non-Contracted Team Users If you are a member of a non-contracted team, reach out to your admin to cancel your subscription.
Alternatively, you can hit Cmd+K or Ctrl+K → Billing Support to have our team cancel your subscription and remove you from the team.
If you are an admin of a non-contracted team, you can remove members by hitting Cmd+K or Ctrl+K → Manage Team or by logging into superhuman.com/admin .

washington-post.source_title: How to cancel your digital-only subscription
evidence_excerpts: You can cancel your subscription at any time.

If you purchased your subscription directly through The Washington Post, you can go to your My Post profile to cancel: https://www.washingtonpost.com/my-post/account/subscription/ When you cancel, we will stop charging your account the following billing cycle.
Your digital access will continue for the remainder of the current billing period.
Afterward, you will still be able to view a limited number of articles a month, just like any other visitor.
